description: This file defines an interface IAttributeToFactoryMapper intended for mapping facet metadata to a cachable factory, specifically in the Orleans runtime. It includes a generic method for obtaining a factory based on parameter info and metadata.

classes.name: IAttributeToFactoryMapper
classes.description: An interface for mapping facet metadata to a cachable factory within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Returns a factory based on parameter info and facet metadata.
